title: Deploy both demo gates with one script
instructions: In Terminal, in the project folder: bash out/cf-review/deploy.sh . It checks the local files, asks you to confirm Cloudflare Access is off, sets a fresh random key for each demo (never shown), deploys both, then prints PASS/FAIL for each live check. Tap Done when it says ALL PASS, or paste only the FAIL lines.
